notes: The quoted text is only the chapter colophon of the text (Devīmāhātmya, ch. 13, fol. 114v6-7). It names no scribe, date or place. The catalogue card gives Scribe: Jaugīndrapati and Date: VS 1963 (≈1906 CE), but neither appears in the quoted excerpt. Presumably they come from a scribal colophon the cataloguer did not quote. They were not extracted because the text does not support them. 'Jaugīndrapati' may be a corrupt form of Yogīndrapati.
